description: Offered for the first time in more than 30 years, 22051 Celes Street comes to market as a beautifully updated residence in one of Woodland Hills' most desirable South of the Boulevard neighborhoods. Blending timeless design with modern livability, the residence showcases quality craftsmanship and carefully selected finishes throughout. Mature landscaping, fruit-bearing trees, and a welcoming front porch create an immediate sense of warmth and character, while thoughtfully updated interiors offer a fresh yet enduring aesthetic. Natural light fills the interiors, enhancing a floor plan designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining. Seamless connections between indoor and outdoor spaces capture the essence of Southern California living, creating an environment that feels equally inviting for quiet mornings and lively gatherings. Beyond the property, some of Woodland Hills' most desirable amenities are just moments away. Tree-lined streets and a distinctly residential setting provide a sense of tranquility, while the restaurants, cafs, boutiques, and conveniences of Ventura Boulevard remain within easy reach. Nearby destinations include Westfield Topanga, The Village, and Warner Center, while the trails and open spaces of the Santa Monica Mountains offer abundant opportunities for hiking, cycling, and outdoor recreation. Convenient access to canyon routes and major freeways further enhances the home's appeal, providing an ideal balance of privacy, accessibility, and lifestyle
